title: I'd like to disconnect the phone

messages.text: I'd like to disconnect the phone, do you have any plan to use it yet ?

Yes, you can disconnect the iPhone now: nothing needs it for at least the next 45 minutes.
- The end-of-page morph work runs on the Simulator and Chrome first (fix A's checks, the toolbar-step counts).
- The next iPhone use is fix A's short "no worse" test on today's best build, once those checks pass.
- After that: the second try of the pictures-versus-titles test, then the AVIF pictures test.
- When the iPhone is needed again, I'll post a "reconnect the iPhone" step in "Your steps"; no test starts without it.
What you need to do: disconnect it whenever you like; reconnect when that step appears.

Thanks, the iPhone is back; I'm restarting its robot-finger tool now so the first test can't fail on it.
- Next on the phone: fix A's short test (P-152), as soon as its plan review ends and I sign it, likely within 20-30 minutes.
- Right after it: fix B's test (P-153), which ends with a blind swipe step for you on the end-of-page morph.
- Until then the phone stays free; please keep it plugged in and unlocked.
What you need to do: nothing now; do the swipe step when it appears in "Your steps".

P-153 is <device-name>; its last part is a blind swipe where you compare two pages at the end of the page only.
- Fix B is the menu reveal you accepted in PR-012: the menu opens as a moving clip instead of repainting the photo wall each frame.
- Page 1 and page 2 are today's build with fix A, one of them also with fix B; you won't know which is which.
- You swipe down into the end section on each page, opening and closing the menu, and pick the one that follows your finger better (or "same").
- Before that, the robot finger runs the same test 8 times by itself; you don't touch the phone then.
- P-152 (fix A's test) is robot-only, no swipe from you.
What you need to do: nothing now; the swipe step will appear in "Your steps" with these instructions.
